annotations.title: Check basic eligibility for a programme

description: Use this when the user asks whether they qualify for a specific Canadian funding programme ("am I eligible for CanExport?", "could I get IRAP?"), or after a search when they give more details about their business. Checks the basic requirements — location, organization type, size, years operating, industry, and whether the programme is reserved for specific founders — and returns which are met, not met, or still unknown, plus the questions to ask for the unknowns. The result is a likelihood, never a guarantee: every programme has further specific conditions, which are counted and listed on its page. Pass the programme name or the `slug` from a search result. Works with partial details: call it even when the user has shared little, because it returns what is already known and lists exactly which questions to ask next.Do not use for: scholarships, bursaries or student aid; personal loans, debt relief, mortgages or household benefits (EI, CPP, child benefit); funding outside Canada (US, UK, EU…); writing a business plan or grant application; investment advice.

annual_revenue_cad.description: Exact annual revenue in CAD, only when the user stated a figure.

employee_count.description: Exact head count, only when the user stated a number (settles thresholds like "at least 3 employees" that a band cannot).

employees.description: Head count band, including the owner (just_me = solo).

founder_groups.description: ONLY if the user has already said so in this conversation: the business is majority-owned by women, Indigenous, Black, youth (under ~39), newcomer, or disabled founders ("none" if they said none apply). Used solely to include programmes reserved for those founders. Never ask for this just to search, and never infer it from a name.

funding_purpose.description: Main thing the money is for.

industry.description: Closest industry. Use "other" if none fit.

organization_type.description: Legal form: incorporated (a corporation), sole_proprietor, partnership, nonprofit (incl. registered charities), not_yet_registered (idea stage), cooperative.

program.description: Programme slug from search_grants (preferred) or its name, e.g. "canexport-smes" or "CanExport SMEs".

province.description: Province or territory where the business or organization is based, e.g. "Ontario", "BC", "Québec". Omit if unknown — never guess.

years_in_business.description: Exact years operating, only when the user stated a number (0 = not launched).

years_operating.description: How long the business has been operating (not_started = pre-launch).
